high_level_description: This image is an advertisement for "InAir," a company that specializes in fresh air ventilation systems. The ad is designed to promote the idea that their product works similarly to how lungs function inside our bodies. Text: The main headline reads: "IT WORKS LIKE LUNGS DO INSIDE OUR BODY." Below the headline, it states: "Get a clean and pure indoor atmosphere. Freedom from Indoor air pollution, humidity, and bad odour."
